title: Jubilant Lentil Wrap
description: A flavorful and nutritious wrap filled with a hearty lentil mixture, perfect for a quick and easy meal. The jubilant and syrian spices add a unique and exciting twist to this classic dish.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add lentils, jubilant spice blend, and syrian sumac. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add tomato and cook until heated through.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Spoon the lentil mixture onto the wrap and serve.
